harmonicAnalysis

Class Chords

  • java.lang.Object
    • java.util.AbstractMap<K,V>
      • java.util.HashMap<Chord,java.lang.Double>
        • harmonicAnalysis.Chords
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    java.io.Serializable, java.lang.Cloneable, java.util.Map<Chord,java.lang.Double>

    public class Chords
extends java.util.HashMap<Chord,java.lang.Double>
    This class represents a collection of chords and how often they occur. The counter is a double type, so chord on unaccentuated times can be counted with a diminished weight.

    • Method Detail

      • analyze

        public static Chords analyze(meico.mei.Mei mei,
                             meico.msm.Msm msm,
                             double weightOfUnaccentuatedChords)
        Perform an analysis of the given MSM and aggregate it with analysis done so far. This method expects a global timeSignatureMap. Otherwise, if there are local timeSignatureMaps, it will take the first it finds. Attention: this method alters the MEI and MSM!
        Parameters:
        mei - the MEI needs to be provided, so we can add annotations to it
        msm - the MSM is the basis for the analysis
        weightOfUnaccentuatedChords - the weight of unaccentuated chords
        Returns:
